description: Publishes one governed provisional organization per Washington UBI from official L&I active contractor-license rows, retaining multiple source-reported names, mailing addresses, and license activities without inferring legal name, physical site, or general operating status.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.wa.gov metadata and m8qx-ubtq JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, ordering failures, source refresh drift, count mismatch, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: The 21-field active-license snapshot is acquired in UBI/license order and hashed before normalization. Metadata and count are rechecked before publication. A complete selected-field staging snapshot can be revalidated without reacquisition; current.json changes only after independent verification.
idempotency: The source rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release; the nine-digit UBI creates a stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Abort network and local processing cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and local-review-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
